base.$description: CLASSIFICATION: PROPOSED, not VERIFIED (artifacts/brand/UKBT-BRAND-FOUNDATION.md) — Lato, self-hosted (packages/truth/../apps/web font files sourced from artifacts/brand/raw/fonts/, SIL OFL). Adopted as an assumption carried from the Adelux reference (EV-20260826-029's own framing), not confirmed by the club. System stack remains as fallback.

heading.$description: CLASSIFICATION: PROPOSED, not VERIFIED — same basis as font.family.base.

size.$description: CLASSIFICATION: DERIVED. A standard 1.25 (major third) modular scale anchored at a 16px/1rem base — a generic typographic convention, not derived from Adelux or any brand fact.

display.$description: CLASSIFICATION: DERIVED — Stage 6 (artifacts/ui/REFERENCE-ANALYSIS.md §2) observed a large hero headline that steps down in discrete bands at the same breakpoints as structural changes. Implemented here as a fluid clamp() covering a comparable size range instead of copying the reference's literal step values — a disclosed improvement (continuous scaling vs. discrete jumps), not a literal port.

weight.$description: CLASSIFICATION: DERIVED — standard numeric weight values, not a brand/font-specific decision.

lineHeight.$description: CLASSIFICATION: DERIVED — standard readability ratios (WCAG 1.4.8 recommends at least 1.5 for body text).
